title: Visibility schedule
preconditions: Console open. Pick species/exhibit used on map.
dateUnderTest: **D** inside the visibility schedule date range.

steps.name: Fill window
steps.do: Set daily viewing start/end, **Schedule start date** / **Last day of schedule** covering D, **Message**.

steps.name: Map limited-viewing cue
steps.do: Map on D; find animal marker badge/limited-viewing styling.

steps.name: Itinerary window
steps.do: On itinerary for D, schedule the animal inside vs outside the daily window if practical.

steps.name: Remove schedule
steps.do: Select **Remove visibility schedule** for same species/exhibit.

steps.name: Submit remove
steps.expect: Success “… no longer has a visibility schedule.”
